reason: Provides Git Bash and WSL2 terminal tools for Windows-based DeepSeek Harness deployments, including command execution, background jobs, optional sandboxing, and approval flows; the documented default full-access execution warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL2 终端工具，支持命令执行、后台任务、可选沙箱和审批流程。
summaries.en: Provides Git Bash and WSL2 terminal tools for DeepSeek Harness on Windows, with command execution, background jobs, optional sandboxing, and approval flows.

capabilities: Executes commands through Git Bash and WSL2 bash
Can read and write local files and paths
Supports background jobs, cancellation, timeouts, and process-tree termination
Provides optional bwrap sandboxing for WSL2
Supports approval prompts and sandbox permission escalation
